subsection.name: Description
subsection.div: Checks that pattern variables that never have their values changed are declared final.
subsection.p: Pattern variables are not implicitly final in Java, and they can be reassigned. This check verifies that pattern variables are explicitly declared as final if they are not reassigned within their flow scope.

subsection.name: Violation Messages
subsection.p: All messages can be customized if the default message doesn't suit you. Please see the documentation to learn how to.
